# Changelog

## Version 3.0.0

Merged `generic_request_contract_service` into `generic_request_contract` module


## Version 1.0.0

Subcontracts removed from the generic_contract.


## Version 0.8.0

#### Version 0.8.0
Added new request event type: 'contract-changed'.


## Version 0.5.0

Changed logic applied to guess contract.
Before, if request has no related partner, no contract selected.
After, if request has no partner, but there are suitable contract for author, then it will be selected


## Version 0.3.0

Provide correct default values for requests created from contracts
